description: Extremely light global AI token usage tracker: incremental local log parsing, proxy-aware model resolution (sees through magpie auto/group routing), cross-vendor model merging, reference pricing. One static exe, no runtime.
notes: Config lives in ~/.config/mtok (mtok config --init writes defaults).
First run builds the database from every supported agent log; later runs only read new bytes.
When magpie runs locally, its call journal is read so proxy-routed usage shows real model names.
